Transluce description (independent “ground truth”, exemplar-based)
The neuron activates on tokens that are isolated or appear in parentheses, often numerical values or phrases (e.g. "to", "(name)").
text excerpts related to health, technology, interpersonal communication, and political issues with factual or report-like presentation styles.
L13·N0unmasked layer
Low-magnitude, diffuse "continuation" neuron: it fires weakly on ordinary function/filler tokens carrying a clause forward (a comma, "in", "your", "can", "same") typically after an "and"-coordinated phrase, and is most strongly *suppressed* on tokens that are copies of something already in context (induction-style repeats like "logical", "re-enable", "29" after "28-year-old", "something/affordable").
